content: Customer Vedant Thakur contacted insurance agent Neha Kapoor to discuss lowering his policy deductible. After reviewing the cost options ($500 vs $750 deductible), the customer opted for a $750 deductible, which increases the annual premium by $75 to $1,275. The agent successfully updated the policy and emailed the revised quote, while also confirming that future deductible adjustments can be made before the September 2027 renewal.

action_items: Check email for the revised quote with the $750 deductible
